placements.rationale: USB connector pushed to the left board edge (outline starts at x=35) and vertically centered so the receptacle overhangs the edge for mating; keeps VBUS/GND entry and the USB_D+/USB_D- pair short into U1.

ESP32-WROOM-32 module placed center-left with its castellated pin rows toward J1 and U2; leaves the module's PCB antenna end pointing to open board area near the right/top edge so no copper or parts sit under the antenna keepout.

TMP102 in the far corner, away from the ESP32 module and the USB power entry, to minimize self-heating error while keeping the two-node I2C bus (SDA/SCL from U1.3/U1.4) short enough for 400 kHz with 4.7k pull-ups.
